open_conflicts.finding: LTC2292 has no CLKOUT pin. Clock pins are CLKA (pin 8) and CLKB (pin 9), both single-ended INPUTS ("input sample starts on the positive edge", p.11). There is no ENC+/ENC- differential pair either. Architecture assumed a CLKOUT that does not exist.
open_conflicts.verified_by: orchestrator, independently: 0 grep hits for CLKOUT across all 28 pages of datasheets/LTC2292_LTC2293_LTC2291_229321fa.pdf

datasheet_facts.clock: CLKA pin 8 / CLKB pin 9, single-ended inputs. p.11. Datasheet RECOMMENDS shorting CLKA and CLKB and driving from the same source; skew must be <1 ns; must not be asynchronous (p. ~1628).
datasheet_facts.data_access_time: 4.3 ns typ / 10 ns max at CL=5pF (Electrical Characteristics p.4)
datasheet_facts.reference: SENSEA (62) / SENSEB (19) are reference PROGRAMMING pins. External 0.5-1 V on SENSE sets input range to +/-V_SENSE. 1.000 V -> +/-1 V = 2 V(P-P), exactly the design span. SENSE=VCM selects internal ref +/-0.5V; SENSE=VDD selects internal ref +/-1V. So driving vref_1v0 onto SENSE gives the design span from the EXTERNAL precision reference - satisfies SPEC 2.1 intent.
datasheet_facts.vcm: VCMA (61) / VCMB (20) are 1.5 V outputs. Datasheet explicitly says "Do not connect to VCMA" / "Do not connect to VCMB" - they must NOT be joined into one adc_vcm net.
datasheet_facts.per_channel_pins: SENSEA/SENSEB, VCMA/VCMB, SHDNA(59)/SHDNB(22), OEA(58)/OEB(23) are all per-channel. net_plan 3.6 describes single SENSE/VREF/SHDN/OE pins that do not exist. SHDNA=SHDNB and OEA=OEB may be tied (no prohibition).
datasheet_facts.mux: MUX (pin 21) is digital output multiplexer control; both 12-bit buses always exist, MUX only swaps A/B mapping.

options.a_RECOMMENDED: FPGA captures ADC data using xo_clk_fpga - the R41 tap off the SAME 40 MHz XO that clock_40m ALREADY provides. Requires NO new parts. SPEC 2.2 is NOT violated: it says the FPGA CONSUMES the clock and never SYNTHESIZES it, and rejects a PLL-DERIVED sample clock. A direct XO tap is consumption. Timing is comfortable: data access 10 ns max against a 25 ns period, so capture on the following edge has ~15 ns margin.
options.b: Re-select an ADC that actually has CLKOUT (LTC228x family, AD92xx). Expensive - LTC2292 is $51.64 and already verified against the 68.5 dB SNR gate.
options.c: Keep a CLKOUT-style topology by other means - no clean path exists on this part.

block_notes.power_digital: 14 parts, compiled clean, footprints validated, standalone instantiation OK. CORRECTION FOUND: skeleton_bom.md (and my work order) said TLV62569DBVR = SOT-23-6. Wrong - DBV suffix = SOT-23-5 (EN,GND,SW,VIN,FB; no PG). SOT-23-6 belongs to the power-good variant in a different package code. Coder used SOT-23-5, matching the LCSC C141836 record which also says SOT-23-5. FB divider: VFB 0.600V, R10=453k/R11=100k -> 3.318V (+0.55%), ~6uA.
